free_tier.stated: free keyless API with no signup: 100 requests a minute per IP address on /api (X-RateLimit-Limit 100 over a 60-second window) and 60 a minute on /api/v1; IP geolocation, ISP, ASN and privacy flags as JSON; POST /api/bulk takes up to 50 IPs
free_tier.notes: no daily or monthly quota is stated; past the per-minute limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

per_object_cap.stated: POST /api/bulk takes up to 50 IPs in one request; GET /api/lookup takes one

retention.stated: not applicable: a lookup API; answers are cacheable for an hour

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://hackmyip.com/api/lookup?ip={ip} and GET /api/v1/ip/{ip} answer JSON with CORS enabled; POST /api/bulk takes a JSON body with an ips array; GET /api/ip answers for the caller
tooling: any HTTP client; X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Window headers on every answer; an npm package named hackmyip is offered
chaining: Keyless city, ISP, ASN and VPN or datacenter flags from Cloudflare Workers at 100 requests a minute per IP. Bulk path: POST /api/bulk, 50 IPs a request, keyless, inside the same per-minute limit.

limits.value: 100 requests a minute per IP address on /api (X-RateLimit-Limit 100, window 60 seconds); 60 a minute on /api/v1

binding_note: the per-minute limit per IP address is the only published cap; no daily or monthly quota is stated.

identity_cost.detail: no signup, no key and no authentication

reliability_note: past the per-minute limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After; if the upstream lookup is briefly unavailable it answers HTTP 503 with success false
confidence_note: A keyless lookup of 8.8.8.8 was probed on 2026-11-02 and returned HTTP 200 with X-RateLimit-Limit 100 and X-RateLimit-Window 60; the page states 100 a minute on /api and 60 a minute on /api/v1, and the limits were not exhausted.

evidence.proved: the API needs no key and asks for under 100 requests a minute
evidence.quote: No API key required. JSON response, CORS enabled. Please keep it under 100 requests per minute.

evidence.proved: the advertised limit is 100 a minute over 60 seconds; /api/v1 is capped at 60 a minute
evidence.quote: Please keep it under 100 requests per minute, the limit our response headers advertise (`X-RateLimit-Limit: 100`, `X-RateLimit-Window: 60`). The `/api/v1/` endpoints are capped at 60 requests per minute.

evidence.proved: answers are cacheable for an hour
evidence.quote: Results are cacheable for an hour.

evidence.proved: the bulk endpoint takes up to 50 IPs in one POST
evidence.quote: Batch lookup up to 50 IPs in a single POST request. Faster than sequential /api/lookup calls.

evidence.proved: the bulk endpoint returns one result per IP, 50 IPs a request
evidence.quote: takes up to 50 IPs in a single POST and returns a result per IP

evidence.proved: the v1 limit is 60 requests a minute per IP address
evidence.quote: 60 requests / minutePer IP address. Resets every 60 seconds. No burst limits.

evidence.quote: 429 Too Many RequestsReturned when rate limit is exceeded. Includes Retry-After header.
